description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the UpdateImage operation, which modifies image information in an Image Search instance
description_zh: 本文为您介绍UpdateImage接口的语法及示例，用于向图像搜索实例中修改图片信息
name: UpdateImage

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Image Search instance. The name can be up to 20 characters in length.
If you have purchased an Image Search instance, log on to the Image Search console (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/) to view the instance name.
If you have not purchased an Image Search instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html.
The instance name is not the instance ID. Do not confuse the two
parameters.help_zh:
图搜实例名称。最多支持20个字符。
如果已经购买图搜实例可登录图像搜索管控台 (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/)查看。
如果没有购买图搜实例可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html。
这里的实例名称并非实例ID，使用时请区分
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The product ID. The ID can be up to 256 characters in length.

A product can have multiple images. Set this parameter based on your business requirements. For example: top001, pants002
parameters.help_zh:
商品ID，最多支持256个字符。

一个商品可以有多张图片。根据实际情况自定义参数值。比如：上衣001号、裤子002号等
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en:
The image name. The name can be up to 256 characters in length.
ProductId and PicName uniquely identify an image. ProductId and PicName cannot be modified.
If you add multiple images with the same ProductId and PicName, only the last added image is retained. Previously added images are overwritten.
If you do not specify PicName, image information is modified based on ProductId.
If you specify PicName, image information is modified based on ProductId and PicName
parameters.help_zh:
图片名称，最多支持256个字符。
ProductId和PicName唯一确定一张图片，且ProductId和PicName无法被修改。
如果多次添加图片具有相同的ProductId和PicName，以最后一次添加为准，前面添加的图片将被覆盖。
如果不填写PicName，则根据ProductId进行修改图片信息。
如果填写PicName，则根据ProductId+PicName进行修改图片信息
parameters.name: pic_name

parameters.help_en:
The custom content. The content can be up to 4,096 characters in length.
This field is returned when you call the "<props="china">SearchImageByPic (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202282.html)</props><props="intl">SearchImageByPic (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/image-search/latest/updateimage)</props>" operation. For example, you can add a text description of the image
parameters.help_zh:
用户自定义的内容，最多支持4096个字符。
调用"<props="china">根据图片查询图片 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/202282.html)</props><props="intl">根据图片查询图片 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/image-search/latest/updateimage)</props>"接口时会返回该字段。例如可添加图片的描述等文本
parameters.name: custom_content
